command:
sed -i 's/^bgpd=.*/bgpd=yes/' /etc/frr/daemons
cat > /usr/local/sbin/antrieb-bgp-peer.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
ip link set enp8s0 up
ip addr flush dev enp8s0 scope global
ip addr add 172.20.1.1/31 dev enp8s0
ip link show bgp-endpoint >/dev/null 2>&1 || ip link add bgp-endpoint type dummy
ip link set bgp-endpoint up
ip addr flush dev bgp-endpoint scope global
ip addr add 192.168.101.1/32 dev bgp-endpoint
EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/antrieb-bgp-peer.sh
cat > /etc/systemd/system/antrieb-bgp-peer.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Dedicated BGP peer link and stable endpoint
After=network-pre.target
Before=frr.service

[Service]
Type=oneshot
RemainAfterExit=yes
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/antrieb-bgp-peer.sh

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
cat > /etc/frr/frr.conf <<'EOF'
frr defaults traditional
hostname node2
service integrated-vtysh-config
log syslog informational
router bgp 65101
 bgp router-id 192.168.101.1
 no bgp ebgp-requires-policy
 neighbor 172.20.1.0 remote-as 65100
 !
 address-family ipv4 unicast
  network 192.168.101.1/32
  neighbor 172.20.1.0 activate
 exit-address-family
exit
line vty
EOF
chown frr:frr /etc/frr/frr.conf
chmod 0640 /etc/frr/frr.conf
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable antrieb-bgp-peer.service frr.service
